subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub adopt the gated Claw package and hosted-feed contract while the cross-repository Claws RFC remains open and awaiting acceptance?
rationale: The patch establishes durable package, API, manifest, ownership, and supply-chain boundaries that code review cannot authorize independently of the OpenClaw product contract.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the stack draft until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC, then rebase, land dependencies in order, and require live Convex lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve experimental incubation
options.body: Explicitly sponsor the unstable gated contract now while documenting that schemas and APIs may change before the gate is removed.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave or close the implementation drafts until the complete-agent packaging direction has stronger product ownership and demand.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the stack draft until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC, then rebase, land dependencies in order, and require live Convex lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible product-model reviewer and code-owner signal spanning the Claws RFC and existing hosted-feed boundary.
